definitions.full: H5412. Nethinin [ נְתִינִין ] noun masculine plural Nethinîn (probably loan-word from Biblical Hebrew נְתִינִים , √ נָתַן ); — servants of sanctuary, emphatic נְתִינַיָּא Ezra 7:24 .
